headline: the provider turn is REAL and running, and the manager nonetheless projects the implementation stage `exceptional` because it reports the worker exchange `unreadable (policy/denied)`. The review stage is blocked behind it. The exact denial is NOT established.
operator_actions_taken: NONE beyond observation. No supervisor stopped while a runtime is live, no mode changed, no file in the attempt tree touched, no Job re-admitted, no retry.

what_is_NOT_established.my_first_reproduction_was_CIRCULAR_and_i: evidence 26-adoption-refusal.json called launch.adopt with the session and contract taken from the attempt's own launch.json, so it necessarily matched and reported ok:true. what_is_NOT_established.the_exact_refusal: the status projection carries only the safe category/code by design -- exchange.py says so in terms: 'WHAT COMES BACK IS SAFE. The category and the code and nothing else'. The prose is not in any file this operator can read.
what_is_NOT_established.whether_the_provider_output_will_be_coll: unknown. A stage projecting exceptional owes no act, and single_worker.refresh_runtime's own docstring says reconciliation 'reconciles only after an answered terminal -- which an exceptional stage never reaches'.

The exchange is written by a running worker and read by a running manager, so only a live run reaches it. This is precisely what the owner selected the live run to discover.
